title: Restaurant Franchise Opportunity
name: Flechazo Gold, 8 Franchisees, Est'd in 2019, Hyderabad HQ
description: Flechazo is an established premium buffet restaurant brand that has been operating for over seven years and has expanded to 15 outlets across Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, and Chennai. The brand is known for its extensive multi-cuisine buffet featuring Indian and international dishes, live counters, grilled specialties, desserts, and a menu that is refreshed every 15 days to encourage repeat customer visits. The business follows a proven franchise-led model, with each outlet requiring an investment of approximately INR 2 crore. Franchise partners receive comprehensive support from the franchisor, including standardized operating procedures (SOPs), proprietary recipes, staff recruitment and training, software systems, branding, procurement support, and operational guidance to ensure consistency in quality and customer experience. The brand primarily caters to corporate clients for team lunches, dinners, and events, as well as families, young professionals, and groups celebrating birthdays, anniversaries, and other special occasions. The combination of premium dining, frequent menu innovation, and standardized operations has enabled the brand to successfully scale across multiple cities. The brand differentiates itself through its wide variety of authentic global cuisines, regular menu rotation, strong operational systems, and end-to-end franchise support. Its established market presence, scalable business model, and structured operating framework make it an attractive opportunity for investors seeking to enter the organized casual dining sector with a recognized and growing restaurant brand. Operates with a valid FSSAI, GST and liquor license.
